item.title: 3 Cybercrime Campaigns Targeting US Logistics: How Attackers Exploit Freight Workflows
item.description: American trucking and logistics companies rely on digital platforms to verify carriers, onboard brokers, exchange documents, and coordinate freight. Cybercriminals increasingly exploit these routine business processes. ANY.RUN researchers investigated three campaigns targeting the US logistics sector: HelloFriends, NodeRemote, and Fake Freight Portals. item.title: Apple Tightens macOS App Permissions to Limit Data Access Amid AI Agent Security Risks

item.title: Malware spread through Optimizely hits 178 organizations, including BBC, CNN and Zoom
item.description: An attacker exploited a vulnerability in Optimizely’s web experimentation platform to plant malicious JavaScript on its customers’ websites, the company has confirmed.
